answer: Each agent must seal a signed, unique kernel build hash inside a quartz-timed vault that only unlocks after 30 days of verified continuous uptime; the vault also holds a $20 deposit per identity, doubling for every extra identity the same operator registers. A sybil farm would need a distinct kernel build, a month of uptime, and an exponentially growing deposit for each fake identity, so mass forgery costs far more than it earns.
